description: Block traffic from known vulnerability scanners and penetration testing tools. Includes more scanners.
Log requests with potential CRLF injection characters in headers. Improved pattern matching.
Block SQL injection, XSS, and path traversal attempts in headers. Improved pattern matching.

Log requests referencing an opaque object id (UUID, or a 32/40-hex path segment) as a weak IDOR signal for correlation. Low score and does not block on its own -- IDOR cannot be decided from the request alone, so matching on common param names (id=, user=, file=) was removed to stop false positives.
Block requests containing potential Java serialized objects, including magic bytes for serialized objects.

Block path traversal attempts and direct access to sensitive files (Target: URI and Headers). Case-insensitive (percent-encoding is emitted in both cases on the wire) and includes a '..%252F' branch for traversal whose slashes are double-encoded.

Block high-confidence path traversal / LFI in the request body (form fields, JSON): '../' repeated (>=2) or direct access to a sensitive file. Conservative on purpose -- a single '../' does not fire -- to avoid false positives on legitimate relative paths in bodies. Complements path-traversal, which covers URI and HEADERS.

Block command injection in query arguments: a shell command that follows an injection metacharacter (; | ` $()), reads a sensitive path, fetches a URL, or is piped to a shell. Requires that context so bare words (a `cat=` param, an `id=` value) do not false-positive. HEADERS was removed as a target: the evaluated header string joins all headers (including Cookie) with semicolons, so any cookie named after a short command word (id=...) matched the metacharacter branch and blocked the request.

Block access to sensitive dotfiles and server internals (.git, .env, .htaccess/.htpasswd, .svn, WEB-INF/META-INF, .dockerenv, server-status). The former generic branch (config|database|backup|...).(json|yaml|...) was removed: it blocked /config.json and similar files that frontends legitimately fetch.
Block SQL injection attempts in request arguments, body, and headers.

Block Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) attempts, including internal IP ranges and cloud metadata endpoints, in body, headers and cookies. Improved pattern matching, more aggressive and includes Azure metadata service.

Block XSS attempts using HTML tags, event handlers, javascript:/vbscript: protocols, and iframe srcdoc. The former data:, style=, HTML-entity and %XX branches were removed: each matched ordinary traffic (YAML bodies, ?style= params, WYSIWYG entities, and any percent-encoded byte).

Block double-percent-encoded injection metacharacters: %2527 ('), %2522 ("), %253C (<), %253E (>), %2500 (NUL). A legitimate client never needs to double-encode a quote, angle bracket, or null byte -- these survive one decode as %XX and target backends that decode twice. Deliberately excludes %252F (double-encoded slash), which appears in legitimate nested/re-encoded URL parameters; traversal with double-encoded slashes is handled by the path-traversal rule's '..%252F' branch instead.
